data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in maximum 30 stocks across market caps (i.e. Multi Cap).
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to seek to generate capital appreciation by investing in a portfolio of select equity and equity linked securities across market caps. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments across market cap*: 65%- 100% of net assets, Debt and Money Market instruments: 0%-35% of net assets, (*Investment in maximum 30 stocks across market capitalisation.) Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.fund_managers: FM 1 Mr. Pratik Dharmshi, FM 2 Mr. Vinod Malviya
data.exit_load: 1% if units are redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 15 days from the date of allotment. Nil thereafter.
